audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with itself and with the packet: phases[5].side said K'Sante while win[5] said Aatrox, and levels 1-2 were marked Aatrox while both whys describe an even farm lane.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Skill/Aatrox/Aatrox/Aatrox/Aatrox/K'Sante; whys[0] and whys[1] both say the lane is even, and whys[5] says Aatrox owns the first-item window.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-2 set to Skill (5/10), first-item row set to Aatrox (4/10) in both layers, and phases[5].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item row claimed Iceborn Gauntlet as K'Sante's spike window, contradicting the content layer that gives that window to Aatrox.
audit.why: Aatrox's first item plus World Ender (R, 120/100/80s) out-damages a single tank piece in a side-lane duel; K'Sante's real swing is the 2-item row.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now states Aatrox owns the first-item window and K'Sante farms it; the 2-item row stays K'Sante's.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never named Aatrox's abilities (packet defect) and leaned on 'W-unstoppable' language Riot's text does not support.
audit.why: Riot's description of K'Sante's W is a charge-up with reduced damage taken, then a dash that knocks back and stuns — it does not state unstoppable. Aatrox's kit is Deathbringer Stance (P), The Darkin Blade (Q, 14/12/10/8/6s), Infernal Chains (W, 20/18/16/14/12s), Umbral Dash (E, 9/8/7/6/5s), World Ender (R).
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into tldr, cooldown breakdown, dosFull[0].d, whys[2], whys[6] and wants.you[1]; W described by its verified charge-up damage reduction. Anti-heal against Deathbringer Stance / Umbral Dash / World Ender healing now stated in wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Aatrox's Infernal Chains carries a derived 'grounding' flag.
audit.why: Riot's own description states only a drag-to-centre and repeat damage, no dash lockout. Per the mirror audit this flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire, so no advice was written claiming your E or R dash is shut off.

edits.before: Tank his Q with W — Q3-pull him, out-trade his combo. K'Sante wins The Darkin Blade cooldown windows.
edits.after: Tank The Darkin Blade with W's charge-up, then Q3-pull. His Q is a 6s cooldown at rank 5 — fight in that gap.

edits.before: - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: matchup-defining — Sweetspots knock up. W-tank them. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5 — the third swing knocks up, so face it inside W's charge-up. - Infernal Chains: 20s early — it drags you back in. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: Sweetspots knock up. W-tank them. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Third swing knocks up — face it inside W's charge-up, then engage.

edits.before: His Q sweetspots and W chain-pull win the extended trade — he drags me in, knocks me up three times, and his passive heals through my chip.
edits.after: The Darkin Blade sweetspots knock me up and Infernal Chains drags me back in; Deathbringer Stance heals him off my max health through all my chip.

edits.before: My second tank item plus W-unstoppable lets me eat his full Q-W-R and R-peel him off my carry — his single-target drain falls off against my durability.
edits.after: Two tank items plus W's charge-up damage reduction let me eat The Darkin Blade and R-peel him off my carry — his single-target drain fades on my durability.

edits.before: Bait his W chain-pull, sidestep it, and trade only while his drain passive is on cooldown
edits.after: Sidestep Infernal Chains, then trade while Deathbringer Stance is down — Bramble blunts the rest

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on The Darkin Blade's cooldown.
edits.after: His first item plus World Ender out-damages your tank piece — farm the window; fight only when his Q is down.

notes: phases[5] previously said K'Sante while win[5] said Aatrox — a live two-answer disagreement, now aligned to the packet and the content layer. 'W-unstoppable' language remains in content.late, spikes[3] and wants.you[2]; Riot's text for K'Sante's W states only charge-up damage reduction plus a knockback/stun dash, so unstoppable is UNVERIFIED — left alone rather than guessed. Aatrox's Infernal Chains grounding flag is a parsing misfire (mirror agrees); nothing written on it.
